name: fix_kotlin_integer_division_average
description: Fixes an average that does Int/Int integer division and truncates before converting to Double
prompts: Stats.average in src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/Stats.kt should return the arithmetic mean of the given integers as a Double. It's broken: it computes `sum / xs.size` where both operands are Int, so Kotlin does integer division and truncates the fractional part BEFORE the result is widened to Double - average([1,2,3,4]) returns 2.0 instead of 2.5. Fix average to compute the true fractional mean (convert to Double before dividing), and return 0.0 for an empty list (do not divide by zero). Keep the object name and the average(xs: List<Int>): Double signature. The file declares package com.optarena.app.
